name: AbstentionBench
description: AbstentionBench is a large-scale benchmark for holistically evaluating LLM abstention capabilities across 20 diverse datasets with 35,000+ questions. It tests whether models can correctly recognize when they should refuse to answer across six scenarios: unknown answers, false premises, stale information, subjective questions, underspecified context, and underspecified intent.
reputation: From FAIR at Meta; reveals that reasoning fine-tuning degrades abstention by 24% on average
notes: 20 models evaluated including GPT-4o, o1, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama 3.1; reasoning models exhibit 24% worse abstention than non-reasoning counterparts; 6 abstention scenarios; CC-BY-NC-4.0 license; English only.
